feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is stated for it. Iterations 0 to 6 (entityR2B scores 53.612, 53.3955, 53.3054, 53.2728, 53.5316, 53.6775, 53.1057) all ended off_track in every trial. max_error stayed at 0.060 to 0.068 m, and line_loss_events was 1 per run from iteration 3 on. Steering_oscillation stayed at 0.07 to 0.16, so the robot drifts rather than jitters. Pitch (iterations 0 to 2), footprint (iteration 3), track (iteration 1), gain (iteration 2), mass (iterations 4 and 5) and wheel_radius (iteration 6, no progress gain) have not moved max_error. The lead test is the only remaining geometry lever. Read the next race as follows. If line_loss_events falls to 0 and max_error drops below about 0.06 m, keep y = 0.06 m and test further lead. If line losses persist at 1 per run with max_error still at the floor, lead alone is not enough, so do not repeat pitch, footprint, track, mass or wheel_radius changes, since each has been tested. Instead, test the footprint extreme.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events is 0 and max_error is below about 0.06 m, try sensor positions at y = 0.08 m (the contract maximum) with x = -0.04 to +0.04 and the other fields unchanged. Evidence: the iteration 7 lead move from y = 0.04 to 0.06 m is the only lever that could reduce lag, and steering_oscillation of 0.07 to 0.16 leaves room for more lead.

If line_loss_events is still 1 per run and max_error stays at the floor, try sensor_size 0.008 at y = 0.06 m with the same x positions. Evidence: 12 mm and 16 mm footprints both gave 1 line loss per run (iterations 2 and 3), so the 8 mm finer footprint is the one size not yet tested.

Do not raise wheel_radius above 0.030 m again or narrow wheel_track below 0.10 m. Evidence: wheel_radius 0.035 gave no progress gain and a lower score (iteration 6, 53.1057), and narrowing the track gave no max_error gain (iteration 1).
